eyebrow.purpose: Compact labels within grouped content, not decorative heading kickers.

arabic-body.purpose: Hadith, dua, and general Arabic text.

quran-arabic.purpose: Diacritic-rich Quran text with generous RTL leading.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 650 0.875rem/1 var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-hover); } .ds-button-primary:active { background: var(--primary-pressed); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action without default elevation.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-primary); color: var(--text-primary); font: 650 0.875rem/1 var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-grouped); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Grouped Surface
components.description: A quiet tonal container for related rows or settings.
components.css: .ds-surface-grouped { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface-grouped); color: var(--text-primary); font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-surface-grouped p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Feature Surface
components.description: Reserved for the single most important content block in a context.
components.css: .ds-surface-feature { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 24px; border-radius: 24px; background: var(--surface-feature); color: var(--surface-feature-foreground); box-shadow: var(--shadow-feature); font-family: var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-surface-feature span { color: var(--surface-feature-muted); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-surface-feature strong { font-size: 2rem; letter-spacing: -0.025em; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A comfortable mobile field with a visible focus state.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface-primary); color: var(--text-primary); caret-color: var(--primary); font: 400 1rem/1.5 var(--font-manrope, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-tertiary); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); outline: 2px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 35%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quran Arabic
components.html: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
components.css: .ds-quran-arabic { margin: 0; direction: rtl; text-align: right; color: var(--text-primary); font: 500 1.875rem/2 var(--font-noto-naskh-arabic, 'Noto Naskh Arabic', serif); font-synthesis: none; }

narrative.overview: A warm, composed, mobile-first system balancing modern iOS restraint with contemporary Islamic editorial craft. Brand character comes from mineral color, careful Arabic typography, and disciplined rhythm rather than ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Dedicated Latin and Arabic type roles
Teal action with restrained brass emphasis

rules.name: Reserved Accent
rules.body: Teal communicates action, selection, or importance; brass marks rare editorial emphasis.

rules.name: Script Integrity
rules.body: Arabic uses a dedicated Naskh face, correct language metadata, RTL direction, and generous leading.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Tonal shifts and hairlines establish groups; elevation is earned by floating or feature-level importance.

dos: Use semantic roles across both themes.
Let content sit directly on canvas when grouping is already clear.
Reserve larger radius and elevation for more important surfaces.
donts: Do not use pure black, cold gray canvases, or bright gold.
Do not stack cards within cards.
Do not decorate with generic religious motifs or calligraphy.
Do not rely on color alone for state.
